summary: Textarea with @mention suggestions for files, people and agents; matched letters are marked and inserted mentions become dotted chips.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label of the textarea, associated with it through `<label for>`. Observed.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.default: Type @ to mention a file, person or agent
attributes.description: Placeholder for the empty textarea. Observed.

attributes.name: value
attributes.default: Can @grace look at @src/auth/session.ts before we ship?
attributes.description: Initial text. Read once on connect; omitting it or leaving it empty loads the demo sentence. Form reset restores it.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name used when the element is inside a form.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the textarea; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on each edit and after a mention is inserted, with the full text.

events.name: mention
events.description: Fires when a suggestion is inserted. `value` is the mention without the `@`, for example `src/auth/session.ts`.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The textarea text. Setting it replaces the text and updates the chips and form value without firing events.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The `name` attribute. There is no setter; set the attribute instead.

keyboard.action: While suggestions are open: move the highlight, wrapping.
While suggestions are open: insert the highlighted mention.
While suggestions are open: close the list.

accessibility: The textarea is named by the visible label and described by the hint line. It has `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"` and `aria-controls` pointing at the suggestion list.

Suggestions use `role="listbox"` and `role="option"`. Focus stays in the textarea; while the list is open, `aria-activedescendant` points at the highlighted option, which also carries `aria-selected`.
Chips and suggestion icons are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, the highlight jumps between suggestions instead of springing and the hint line changes without rolling; the flash on an inserted chip still plays.
form: Submits the full text under `name`. There is no validation. Form reset restores the text from the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset disables the textarea.
notes: Suggestions come from a built-in list of six demo entries (three files, two people and one reviewer agent) and cannot be configured. Up to five matches show; the query matches the name or the description.
The list opens after an `@` at the start of the text or after whitespace, followed by letters, digits, `.`, `/`, `_` or `-`.
Only mentions from the built-in list are drawn as chips. The textarea grows with its content from a minimum of 92px.
The inner textarea's native `input` events stay inside the shadow root, so `input` listeners on the host receive one event per keystroke, the element's own, with `detail.value`.

data.note: The six suggestions (files, people and an agent) are invented; only `label`, `placeholder` and `value` can be set.
